messages.subject: Re: Newbie, my runapps example from tutorial can't find the app
parts:
This is more of a shiny package/coding question; this type of question should be posted to shiny-discuss forum:

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/shiny-discuss

But to answer your question, the content of your files also matter. There might be coding issues in your files that is causing that error. Do you want send you code? Or you could start with an auto-generated Shiny application. In RStudio IDE you can create a new project and select Shiny Application. This will create all the code you need for a simple app. Then try runApp() for this code. This should work. If this does not, then something else is wrong.

Fereshteh
